name: Mortal Kombat: Deception — Goro Biography
notes: Official in-game Goro biography reproduced by Mortal Kombat Warehouse, used as preservation/access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. Goro describes being found and revived by Shao Kahn, explicitly recognizing that it was truly him, after which the two flee into hiding to regain their strength. This independently confirms the real Shao Kahn was alive after the earlier death portrayal without identifying the exact identity of the figure attacked by the Deadly Alliance.
